Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest

General

Version

Winter Update 2010

Status

Active
See also: Quests

Legend

The outlaws are in hard times and are looking for someone to help them...

Location

Outlaw Camp

Dangers

Wild Warriors, Bandits, Smugglers, Boars and other Outlaw Camp creatures.

Reward

2,500 gp, 1600 experience, possible chance to get Hunting Horn or Time Ring, Achievements Merry Adventures and Bunny Slipped.

History

The first day after Updates/8.6 there was a bug with the Achievement Bunny Slipped and everyone got it just by doing the Lucky Loop task twice. Nowadays the only way to earn that Achievement is to give 7 Fake Rabbit's Feet to Rottin Wood. In this case, you will receive 300 gp instead of the normal prize.

Spoiler • edit


Required Equipment

  • Obsidian Knife or Kitchen Knife (one spawns daily on the Timber Table next to Rottin Wood))
  • Hammer

Method

Mission 1: Lucky Charms


Go to Rottin Wood's house in Outlaw Camp. Ask him for a mission and agree to help him. He will hand you 7 Handcrafted Ribbons and ask you to get some Rabbit's Feet. Kill some Rabbits around the camp and use a Kitchen Knife or an Obsidian Knife on their bodies (you have to wait 10 seconds before skinning). You will have a chance of getting 1, 2 or failure to get any Rabbit's Feet. You can skin successfully up to 7 Rabbits (total of 7-14 Rabbit's Feet), afterwards a message appears telling that you have skinned enough for today. Once you have 7 feet or more, use the Handcrafted Ribbons on the feet to make Rabbit's Foot Lucky Charms. Return to Rottin Wood and tell him that you completed this mission. Note: If you lose the Handcrafted Ribbons, you will need to wait approximately 30 minutes to get more from Rottin Wood.

  • You will receive 100 experience and 500 gp.

Mission 2: In a State of Disrepair


Ask Rottin Wood for another mission. He will tell you to repair broken walls around the camp. To repair, use a Hammer on a broken wall. Once you fixed a wall it will become broken again after 2 minutes so you can repair it again (you can fix the same wall 6 times). There are 4 walls in need of repair in the vicinity of Rottin Wood - just look on the walls on some of of the buildings around him. There is also a wall which needs repairing on the top floor of his house. When you have repaired all 6 walls go back to Rottin Wood and report that you completed this mission.

The places you need to repair:

  • Here (32661, 32200, 7)

- Two floors up in Rottin Woods house :

  • Here (32645, 32184, 7)
  • Here (32659, 32213, 7)
  • Here (32647, 32215, 7)
  • Upstairs here (32680, 32209, 7)
  • You will receive 500 experience and 500 gp.

Mission 3: Bushwhacking


Ask Rottin Wood about the next mission. He needs your help trapping passing merchants and will mark the spot on your Automap. Head north, place all the 5 Nets (use them on the ground) and you will be kicked from the area. You will be blocked out of it by a Small Fir Tree. Wait until 5 of the Travelling Merchants enter the nets and after 5 minutes the tree will disappear.

Re-enter the area and 'USE' the Captured Merchants to loot them. After looting all 5, head back to Rottin Wood. Note: If you fail to collect all 5 of the valuables from the merchants, you will need to wait 30 minutes to get more from Rottin Wood.

  • You will receive 1000 experience, 500 gp and the Achievement Merry Adventures.

Daily Task: Lucky Loop

This task is the same as the first mission. Collect the 7 Rabbit's Feet and use the Handcrafted Ribbons to make Rabbit's Foot Lucky Charms.

Note: You may also hand 7 Fake Rabbit's Feet and receive the Achievement Bunny Slipped. To make Fake Rabbit's Feet, use the Handcrafted Ribbons on Wooden Spoons to get Spoons with Ribbon and then use them on Wool. Once you are done, return to Rottin and tell about your task.

  • You will receive 100 experience and one of the following: 500 gp (90% of probability), 300 gp and Time Ring (9%), or Hunting Horn (1%?).(When you receive the horn Rottin Wood tells you: Good hunt. That will be enough to help us uhm... get through the winter yes. And here is a very special reward for you. I hope you know how to use something like that, heh.).

Daily Task: Handyman

This task is the same as the second mission, he will tell you to repair broken walls around the camp using a Hammer. When you have repaired 6 walls go back to Rottin Wood and tell him that you completed the task.

  • You will receive 500 experience and 500 gp.

Rottin Wood: Hunter's greeting! I assume you want something from me since you came all the way out here on your own. This is a dangerous place to be, I doubt that all my men will accept strangers like I do. You don't seem to have any problems with that, though.
Player: quest
Rottin Wood: Oh, you want some work? You can help us, alright. Did you know that the people of the city think those rabbit feet are actually lucky charms?
Player: no
Rottin Wood: People like to think that their personal luck will rise if they buy, wear or give away one of these rabbit feet. ...
Rottin Wood: Of course you and me know that this is complete nonsense but our valued customers want to be supplied with the finest rabbit feet the forest has to offer. ...
Rottin Wood: And that's exactly where you come in - helping us getting more 'lucky charms'. And if we do not get our hands on them in time, we will surely starve... during the dry period, real hard times. You in?
Player: yes
Rottin Wood: Fine, now hurry into the woods and find some rabbits. Find them and kill them that is. Use a sharp, thin knife to get the rabbit foot and be careful not to destroy it - no one would buy it in a bad condition after all. ...
Rottin Wood: Once you gathered some rabbit feet, put one of our - handcrafted by the guys - ribbons on each of them. That will make two lucky charms per rabbit. ...
Rottin Wood: We will need at least seven. And seven is a lucky number, don't you think? Heh. ...
Rottin Wood: If you need some more ribbons just come back to me and I will see what I can do.

Rottin Wood: Once all of them are trapped in the nets, you can go down and gather anything of value you can find. But only take what we... you really need - around 100 gold should be enough for any man to take. ...

Rottin Wood: You're done if you get at least... let's say 5 of these fools. Return to me and you will be rewarded. ...
